title: Harden credential diagnostics and provider metadata
description: Prevent header-only auth leakage in OpenAI diagnostics, preserve successful request IDs across adapters, normalize available usage/rate-limit metadata, and add redaction/metadata tests.

logs.msg: Implemented header-only OpenAI diagnostic redaction, successful request-ID fallback, OpenAI token usage, bounded research token/quota aggregation, and standard rate-limit header propagation. Verification: 116 tests/270 assertions and TypeScript pass.
